findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_app, update_plan, get_job, preview_page, search_screenshots · Private data: analyze_app, add_screens, publish_pages, get_usage · Public sink: add_screens, edit_page, publish_pages, confirm_publish, search_screenshots, score_screenshots · Destructive: update_plan, add_screens.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_app, update_plan, get_job, preview_page, search_screenshots · Private data: analyze_app, add_screens, publish_pages, get_usage · Public sink: add_screens, edit_page, publish_pages, confirm_publish, search_screenshots, score_screenshots · Destructive: update_plan, add_screens

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
